message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a caricatured man in a red and black striped jacket and white pants. He leans forward, playing a black flute with his hands and fingers. A large bag slung over his shoulder, labeled "sutiyoso" in lowercase, overflows with banknotes. Behind him is a stylized tree with swirling, dark branches. 

To the man’s left, a line of multi-colored ducks (yellow, blue, purple, pink, white, orange) trails into the distance over a green hill under a blue sky with white clouds. Each duck carries a banknote in its beak. Several dark rats are also present: one in the bottom-right corner holding a stick, and others partially visible on the left hill. 

The top of the cover displays the text "Tosari Widjaja dan Skandal Investasi PPP" in white against a dark bar. The red magazine title "TEMPO" dominates the upper third. Below it, the date "EDISI 16-22 September 2002" appears in small blue text. Large yellow block letters state "KE JAKARTA AKU KAN KEMBALI...". A barcode is located in the bottom-left corner.
